FN-FKREWC5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 6
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/03/2026
Senate Bill 6 as introduced would revise the penalty on entities that fail to get a waiver to
rename, relocate, remove, alter or otherwise disturb public property until the property has been
restored to its original condition from $25,000 per violation to $5,000 per day per violation until
full restorative action has been taken to comply with the provision of the Alabama Memorial
Preservation Act.
This bill would increase the obligations of the governmental entities that maintain
architecturally significant buildings or memorial buildings, by an undetermined amount, to erect
markers naming any resulting building, park or green space after the individual or event the
building was originally named.
This bill would also authorize the Attorney General to stay the fines upon submission of
supporting documentation that restoration has begun.
